## Goal
Build a one-page Sale Price Calculator, `index.html`. You type a price and a discount, and the page shows the sale price and how much you save. Build it test first: each rule below is written as a test and shown FAILING before the code that makes it pass. See README.md for the full walkthrough.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] $50 with 20% off → $40.00
- [ ] $19.99 with 15% off → $16.99 (rounded to the cent)
- [ ] A discount over 100% → shows "A discount can't be more than 100%"
- [ ] Each rule above has an automated test, and each test was seen failing before its code was written
- [ ] Opening `index.html` in a browser, you can type a price and a discount and see the sale price and how much you save
